name: activity-log
description: Unified activity tracker across local Git, GitLab and Jira
author: Teodora Zaharinova <teodora.zaharinova@inform-software.com>

scripts.dashboard:lint: eslint . && node --test scripts/eslint-message-rule.test.mjs scripts/dev-proxy.test.mjs scripts/touch-styles.test.mjs scripts/shortcut-listeners.test.mjs
scripts.dashboard:browsers: pnpm --dir dashboard exec playwright install --only-shell chromium
scripts.dashboard:build: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir dashboard run build
scripts.dashboard:build:prod: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir dashboard exec ng build --configuration production
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir desktop exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir desktop exec tauri build
scripts.desktop:build:windows: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir desktop exec tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.win:test: cd infra/windows-vm && vagrant rsync && vagrant ssh -c "cd C:/vagrant; cargo test --workspace --exclude activity-log-desktop"
scripts.win:collect: cd infra/windows-vm && vagrant rsync && vagrant ssh -c "cd C:/vagrant; cargo run -p cli --bin activity-log --"
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run api:dev" "pnpm run dashboard:dev" --names api,ng --prefix-colors cyan,blue
scripts.verify: pnpm run types:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run rust:check && pnpm run rust:clippy && pnpm run rust:test && pnpm run dashboard:lint && pnpm run dashboard:test && pnpm run dashboard:test:layout && pnpm run dashboard:typecheck && pnpm run dashboard:build
